text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Thursday:
At Chesterfield: Derbyshire 523 (A.Rollins 210, P.Aldred 83, C.Adams 79) v Hampshire 166-2 (J.Laney 61).
At Chester-le-Street: Sussex 373 (N.Lenham 93, P. Moores 60) v Durham 309-9 (J. Lewis 89, M. Foster 56; V. Drakes 4-77).
At Tunbridge Wells: Warwickshire 314 (T.Penney 84; J.Thompson 5-89) v Kent 319-8 (D. Fulton 73 A.Wells 70).
At Lord's: Leicestershire 280 (J. Whitaker 110; A.Fraser 6-77) v Middlesex 298-4 (M. Ramprakash 97, M. Gatting 94).
At Northampton: Northamptonshire 235 (D.Ripley 77; M.Bowen 5-57) v Nottinghamshire 259-9 (W. Moon 83; K. Curran 4-59).
At Taunton: Lancashire 88 (K.Shine 7-43) and 164 (K. Shine 4-54) v Somerset 189 (P.Bowler 53; P.Martin 4-29, G Chapple 4-80) and 66-3 (Somerset beat Lancashire by 7 wickets.
At The Oval: Essex 347 (D.Robinson 98, R.Rollins 56) and 40-0 v Surrey 280 (A. Brown 109; A. Cowan 5-58).
At Headingley: Gloucestershire 205 (M.Lynch 60) and 281-5 (A. Wright 79 M. Lynch 64) v Yorkshire 183 (R. Blakey 51 not out; A. Smith 6-58).
